Pentecost: the tongues of fire descending + Peter's sermon citing Joel 2's cosmic signs
The lame man healed at the Beautiful Gate + Peter's sermon in Solomon's Portico
Peter and John before the Sanhedrin + the believers hold all things in common
Ananias and Sapphira struck down + the apostles freed from prison by an angel; Gamaliel's counsel
The seven chosen to serve + Stephen seized on false charges
Stephen's speech: the history of Israel + his martyrdom by stoning
Persecution scatters the church; Philip in Samaria; Simon Magus + the Ethiopian eunuch baptized
Saul's conversion on the Damascus road + Peter heals Aeneas and raises Tabitha
Cornelius the centurion + Peter's vision of the sheet: the Spirit poured out on the Gentiles
Peter defends the Gentile mission + Antioch, where the disciples are first called Christians
Herod kills James; Peter's angelic prison release + the death of Herod
Barnabas and Saul commissioned + Paul's sermon at Pisidian Antioch
Iconium, Lystra, and Derbe: the lame man healed + mistaken for Zeus and Hermes; Paul stoned
The Jerusalem Council: the Gentile-inclusion decision + the apostolic decree
The Macedonian call + Lydia's conversion and the Philippian jailer; the midnight earthquake
Thessalonica and Berea + Paul at the Areopagus (Mars Hill): the unknown-god speech and the Aratus quote
Corinth: Aquila and Priscilla, Gallio's ruling + Apollos at Ephesus

Eutychus raised at Troas + Paul's farewell to the Ephesian elders at Miletus

Paul before the Sanhedrin + the plot to kill him and the transfer to Caesarea

The voyage to Rome + the storm and shipwreck on Malta

subtitles.en: The spread of the early Christian movement from Jerusalem to Rome

descriptions.en: The second volume of Luke's two-part work. Acts narrates the founding of the Jerusalem community at Pentecost, the missions of Peter and Paul, and the spread of the early Christian movement across the Roman empire — ending with Paul under house arrest in Rome.
